about.tagline: Free, self-hosted NAS and server OS with a web desktop.
about.story: Pandora never opened a box: she opened a pithos, a great storage jar, which Erasmus later mistranslated as a box. What stayed inside was hope, and Pithyx keeps what matters, on your hardware.
